name: gateway-quality-tools
description: External measurement tools the quality engine executes, installed as a self-contained project so their resolved dependency graph is recorded in a lockfile instead of being re-derived from whatever a package cache happens to hold. Pins are EXACT and deliberate: package.json and bun.lock here are hashed into toolchainDigest, so changing a pin invalidates accepted baselines rather than silently re-scoring the tree under a different instrument.
